title: Container killed for exceeding its memory limit

root_cause.summary: The worker container allocates more memory (~200M) than its 64Mi limit and is OOMKilled, which surfaces as CrashLoopBackOff.

required_evidence: Last terminated state reason is OOMKilled (exit code 137)
red_herrings: CrashLoopBackOff is a symptom, not the cause
The node has plenty of free memory; this is a cgroup limit, not node pressure
fix: Raise the container memory limit above the real working set, or reduce what the workload allocates.
